title: Last Bell, 2026
logline: Last Bell from the Legacy across the road, the back of a head, the school through the windshield, and on the school's steps a girl of sixteen in an apron — Gully's daughter — waiting for her brother. The page knows them both from the back seat.

panels.composition: From the back seat of a station wagon: the back of a graying head at the wheel, a high school through the windshield at the last bell, and on its steps a teenage girl in an apron waiting, an old dog's chin on the seat back.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, from the back seat of an old station wagon, the back of a graying man's head at the wheel and through the windshield a high school at the last bell with a teenage girl in an apron waiting on the steps, an old dog's chin on the seat back, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
